selected_model.pattern_label_caution: Pattern labels are run-specific; prose should use IFN-associated pattern unless describing a specific saved run.

decision_status: Leading selected model pending CoGAPS team feedback
decision_summary: K6 is selected because it preserves the dominant IFN/ISG program, retains more non-IFN structure than K4, remains parsimonious relative to K7 and high-K models, and has practical runtime under sparse optimization.

rank_interpretation.interpretation: Fast and strong for the IFN program, but biologically compressed because it merges more non-IFN structure.
Intermediate lower-rank model; useful for checking whether the K6 decision depends on one extra pattern.

learner_path_policy.full_reproduction_path: Optionally rerun the selected K6 model locally in R or Python if large inputs and sufficient compute are available.
